news.title: VentureBeat Research: Where enterprise AI agent governance hasn't caught up
news.summary_raw: Enterprises deployed AI agents ahead of the controls needed to manage them — and they did it knowingly. That is the central finding across the five parallel surveys VentureBeat Research fielded in June, spanning every layer of the agentic stack. news.summary: Enterprises have been deploying AI agents without necessary governance controls, leading to a retrofitting effort to meet their own standards. This has led to budgeting for potential vendor changes within the next 12 months.
news.enterprise_use: Note that many organizations are still developing AI governance standards, which may lead to future updates in existing tooling or vendor changes. This could create uncertainty around future MDM, SSO, or endpoint security offerings.
